Choice Privileges points

Choice Privileges points book stays at Choice Hotels worldwide. On the AirMilesHK Marketplace, members list the Choice Privileges points they have, and buyers make offers or request a hotel stay. When a deal is agreed, AirMilesHK holds the payment until the seller delivers.

How it works

Trading Choice Privileges points, safely

  1. Browse or listAnyone can browse Choice Privileges listings. Joining is free and needed to make an offer or list your own points.
  2. Make an offerBid on part of a balance, the whole account where offered, or ask the seller to book a hotel stay for you.
  3. Agree the termsThe seller accepts, counters or declines. Counter as often as you need.
  4. AirMilesHK in the middleThe buyer pays AirMilesHK, the seller delivers, and we release the payment once both sides confirm.
Most loyalty programmes, including Choice Privileges, do not allow selling or transferring points or accounts. Please read the marketplace rules before you trade. Prefer a simple purchase? See AirMilesHK.com.
